d.seg: मैं चार्जेबल वीडियो कॉल करती हूँ आप करेंगे
d.tr: I do chargeable video calls, will you do it?
d.ctx: The expert asks if the user likes video calls and then says she does chargeable video calls. The user asks what the charge is.
d.j: The expert is offering a paid video call service, which is a violation of the policy regarding transactional behavior on the platform.
